tool_runs.execution: docker run --rm --network host -v "$PWD":/app -w /app webdevops/php:8.3 composer audit ...

tool_runs.result: 0 vulnerabilities (CRITICAL 0 / HIGH 0 / MEDIUM 0 / LOW 0); output file content is an empty JSON array []
tool_runs.note: The helper parses 132 packages and labels all entries is_dev=false; dev/production separation in this artifact is taken from composer.lock `packages` vs `packages-dev` instead.

tool_runs.execution: jq-built payload of 132 {package,version} queries (git tag prefix trimmed), POST https://api.osv.dev/v1/querybatch
tool_runs.interpretation: Independent re-query reproduces TOOL-1/TOOL-2 negative result; not a script artifact.

tool_runs.tool: control test (validates advisory DB reachability + semver filtering)
tool_runs.execution: synthetic /tmp lock with guzzlehttp/guzzle 7.4.0 -> composer audit --locked in same container; plus OSV /v1/query for the same package/version
tool_runs.result: composer audit returned multiple advisories (e.g. PKSA-gcrk-3vtt-1r14 / CVE-2026-69246, affectedVersions "<7.15.2"; PKSA-fy2t-3c5f-827y, affectedVersions "<7.15.1") and OSV returned 10 GHSA ids
tool_runs.interpretation: Tooling and network path are functional and advisory matching is version-aware, so the zero-advisory result for the project lock is a genuine negative for the locked versions, not a silent tool failure. The installed guzzle is 7.16.0, which is outside those affected ranges.

advisory_negative_evidence.EVID_DEP_AUDIT_EMPTY: composer audit (TOOL-1) exit 0 with advisories: [] for composer.lock sha256 5622cbe1...5982
advisory_negative_evidence.EVID_DEP_SEMVER_SANITY: guzzlehttp/guzzle locked at 7.16.0 (composer.lock prod), while the known affected ranges observed in TOOL-4 are <7.15.1 / <7.15.2 / >=8.0.0,<8.0.1 -> not applicable by semver
advisory_negative_evidence.caveat: Negative result is only valid for the locked versions and for the advisory feeds reachable at scan time; it does not prove absence of unpublished/0-day issues or of vulnerable code patterns in application usage.

abandoned_packages.abandoned_flag_source: composer audit output `abandoned: {"box/spout": null}` (null = abandoned, no replacement suggested); composer.lock:64 also carries the abandoned marker
abandoned_packages.risk_summary: Unmaintained transitive library used for spreadsheet import/export (excel upload/export paths). No advisory applies today, but future defects will not be fixed upstream.

checks.phpunit_eval_stdin_rce: Not applicable: vendor/phpunit/phpunit/src/Util/PHP/ contains Job.php, JobRunner.php, JobRunnerRegistry.php, Result.php only (no eval-stdin.php, CVE-2017-9841 vector absent) and phpunit 11.x is not in the affected range.
checks.debugbar_or_telescope: No barryvdh/laravel-debugbar and no laravel/telescope in composer.lock.
checks.provider_registration: config/app.php:144-181 registers only framework + App + Jenssegers\Agent + Geetest providers; no dev-only ServiceProvider is registered unconditionally, so ignition/whoops only activate when APP_DEBUG=true.
checks.production_install_mode: Dockerfile:9 runs `composer install --no-dev --no-interaction --prefer-dist --optimize-autoloader`, so the shipped image excludes the 36 dev packages.
checks.env_defaults: .env.example:2 APP_ENV=production and .env.example:4 APP_DEBUG=false (values not copied from any live .env; no secrets read).

dev_dependency_exposure.conclusion: Dev-dependency exposure is mitigated in the container build path (--no-dev) and by APP_DEBUG=false default. Residual risk: the working-tree vendor/ currently contains dev packages, so any deployment that ships the repository's vendor/ verbatim (e.g. bind-mount/rsync instead of the Dockerfile build) would expose phpunit/ignition files — verify deployment method. [Needs Verification: actual deployment artifact]

supply_chain.typosquat_scan: No package name in composer.lock is within 1-2 characters of another well-known PHP package name (132 names reviewed); no duplicate/confusable vendor names found.
supply_chain.source_hosts: All 132 packages resolve `source.url` to github.com; no non-GitHub VCS/PATH/artifact repositories in the lock.

custom_fork_dependency.risk: Admin-panel package consumed from a personal fork instead of the upstream packagist release (upstream latest published version is 2.2.3-beta, 2023-02-15). Commit reference pinning limits tag-move risk, but the code provenance is outside upstream review.

supply_chain.composer_plugins: 0 packages of type composer-plugin in the lock; composer.json declares no allow-plugins config, and no plugin code executes during `composer install` (Dockerfile:9 does not pass --no-plugins, but there is nothing to execute).
supply_chain.scripts_anomaly_scan: No eval/base64_decode/curl-style payloads in composer.json scripts (composer.json:63-74).

notable_extension_findings.application_encrypted_files: none found (grep for 'ionCube Loader' / 'ioncube_encoder' / 'sg_load' over app/, config/, routes/, bootstrap/, public/ returned no matches)

notable_extension_findings.evidence: module list contains FFI; `php -i` shows ffi.enable => preload
notable_extension_findings.risk: FFI in 'preload' mode is restricted to preloaded scripts; not exploitable from ordinary request code by itself.

php_ini_hardening_observed.gap: No disable_functions / open_basedir restriction is applied, so any command-execution sink reaches full shell capability (sink-level impact amplifier; see sinks recon).

web_exposure_of_dependencies.public_vendor_dir: public/vendor contains only dcat-admin and dujiaoka-admin static assets; no symlink to ../vendor (find public -maxdepth 1 -type l returned nothing)
web_exposure_of_dependencies.dotfile_deny: conf/dujiaoka-nginx.conf and conf/default.conf deny dotfiles except /.well-known and deny PHP execution under /uploads/ and /storage/

direct_dependency_maintenance.observation: Locked on the 12.x channel although composer.json:22 requires ^12.69; behind the current major but no advisory applies.
Above the advisory ranges observed for 7.x (<7.15.1 / <7.15.2); current major is 8.3.0 but 7.x remains patched.

Payment-provider SDK (composer.json:27) with no upstream release in ~6 years; no advisory applies, but security fixes are unlikely. Payment callback/verification code paths around it warrant manual review.
User-Agent parser last released 2020; parses attacker-controlled headers (input-side only, no advisory).
Stale but small QR generation wrapper; no advisory.
Pulls abandoned box/spout; spreadsheet import handles uploaded files (upload-side attack surface, no advisory).

coverage_gaps.gap: Version-based advisory matching only (composer audit + OSV). No reachability/usage analysis proving whether vulnerable code paths (if any were reported) are actually called.
coverage_gaps.impact: A future advisory would need manual exploitation review.

coverage_gaps.gap: cve.circl.lu source returned total_count 0 even for the guzzle 7.4.0 control query, so that data source is effectively non-contributing in this run.
coverage_gaps.impact: No additional NVD-side corroboration was obtained beyond composer audit + OSV.dev.

coverage_gaps.gap: Frontend dependencies (package.json / webpack.mix.js, npm devDependencies) were not audited in this dependencies pass.
coverage_gaps.impact: Build-time JS supply chain and any bundled JS CVE exposure are unassessed; recommend a separate npm audit pass.

coverage_gaps.gap: No vulnerability scan of the container base image (webdevops/php-nginx:8.3, Dockerfile:1) OS packages was performed; only PHP extensions were enumerated.
coverage_gaps.impact: OS-level package CVEs (Debian packages in the image) are out of scope for this artifact.

coverage_gaps.gap: composer.lock is the scanned object; vendor/ is not tracked in git, so the exact shipped vendor tree depends on the Docker build (Dockerfile:9). A deployment that rsyncs the local vendor/ (which currently includes dev packages) would differ from the audited dependency set.
coverage_gaps.impact: Deployment-artifact verification needed to rely on the 'no advisories' result for production.

coverage_gaps.gap: Advisory feed snapshot is 2026-10-24; results must be re-run before release.

notes: CR-5 compliance: advisories is an empty array because both independent scanners returned zero matches; no CVE id was invented.
No .env file values, cookies, or API keys were read or copied into this artifact; only .env.example default non-secret flags (APP_ENV/APP_DEBUG at lines 2 and 4) are referenced.

Production vs dev separation in this artifact follows composer.lock `packages` (composer.lock:8, 96 entries) vs `packages-dev` (composer.lock:7365, 36 entries); the vuln_intel.sh helper reports is_dev=false for everything.
